stories.title: Be boring? Lane Kiffin is anything but as he enters a new era at LSU
stories.summary: Kiffin chose LSU as the path of least resistance to win a title. Anything short of that will bring a legion of critics.

stories.title: SEC files suit vs. LSU over its intent to play pros
stories.summary: The SEC has filed a lawsuit against LSU the school's "unequivocal intent" to utilize players, who recently participated in NFL training camps, during the upcoming season.

stories.title: Sources: Rockets, Thompson agree to $208M deal
stories.summary: Houston Rockets guard Amen Thompson has agreed to a five-year, $208 million rookie-scale contract extension with the franchise, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Athletic: Russini-Vrabel ties violated standards
stories.summary: Former Athletic reporter Dianna Russini's relationship with Mike Vrabel violated newsroom standards but showed no clear bias toward the Patriots head coach, The Athletic said Thursday.

stories.title: Sources: Cards WR Wilson gets $75M extension
stories.summary: The Cardinals have signed wide receiver Michael Wilson to a three-year extension, with sources telling ESPN and NFL Network that the wide receiver's new deal is worth $75 million.
